message:
2 helper(s) imported from a relative module under a name no vocabulary can match:
      card.spec.ts:2 — `expect`, imported from `./support/fixtures`: an `expect` of the suite's own, whose matchers are no retrying assertion
      static.spec.ts:4 — `expect`, imported from `./support/fixtures`: an `expect` of the suite's own, whose matchers are no retrying assertion
    Every
why: The fixtures module's `expect` extended with a matcher of the suite's own, `toHaveRim`, which reads the rim once and compares. Points 3 and 4 take every `await expect(…)` for Playwright's retrying assertion, which closes the window an action opened — this one reads in the window it is taken to close, and the race after the hover goes by unreported. The reference's `static.spec.ts`, which takes its `expect` from the same module, is refused with it.
